notes.title: Hey, guys!
notes.notes:
Finally GRAY got into the Steam library. Oh, I'm so happy about it!
I see that many of you enjoyed the game. Nothing warms my heart as much as knowing that someone likes what I do. 
And know what? I'm currently developing my second game - Areas of GRAY. As you could understand, this is the continuation of GRAY.

You can find more information about it on my [url=https://www.patreon.com/NOTvil][b]PATREON[/b][/url]  You can even try it (a lot of content is available already) This is not a platformer anymore, it has different gameplay mechanics, but it also enjoyable. New characters, new environments, better graphics and much... much more lewd stuff!
So... if you are interested, find me there :)

Sincerely yours
NOTvil.
